models_evaluated: postpartum hospital use (PHU) risk calculator derived from a validated prediction model

links.outcome: 30-day postpartum hospital use after navigation and education for patients flagged high-risk by the calculator
links.effect: Hospital use was 20.0% in the intervention group vs 16.4% in controls (RR 1.2, 95% CI 0.7-2.0). Estimates did not suggest reduced hospital use. Secondary outcomes were similar between groups.
links.quote: Incidence was 20.0% among intervention participants and 16.4% among control participants (risk ratio [95% confidence interval] = 1.2 [0.7-2.0]).

links.outcome: Compatibility of model input definitions with local medical record data during real-time risk scoring
links.effect: Coordinators reported time-intensive abstraction, discrepancies between variable definitions in administrative data (model development) and medical records (recruitment), and missing data.
links.quote: Coordinators reported challenges to risk calculator use, including time-intensive abstraction, discrepancies between variable definitions in administrative data (model development) and medical records (recruitment), and missing data.

unlisted_practices: Using a validated risk calculator with a cut-point to select high-risk patients for enrollment in a targeted postpartum education and navigation intervention

screen.reason: Evaluates the implementation and feasibility of using a risk prediction model to identify high-risk postpartum patients for a clinical navigation intervention in a prospective trial.
